title: audit plugin per-repo config (.claude/audit.config.json)
description: Layer 1 of the plugin's extensibility model. Every key is optional; omitted keys fall back to the defaults in hooks/_config.py DEFAULTS. Unknown keys are tolerated (forward-compat) but reported as warnings by validate-config.py.

manifestPath.description: Path (project-dir-relative) to the audit manifest JSON. Default docs/audit/audit-plan.json.

gitRoot.description: Path (project-dir-relative) of the git repository root where git + build/gate commands run. Default '.'.

exemptGlobs.description: Globs whose edits skip the plan-first / TDD / bash-write guards (docs, tests, .claude/**, the manifest).

trivialLineThreshold.description: First-touch file edits at or below this many lines are allowed without a plan. Default 80.

stateDir.description: Directory for the hooks' transactional state files. Default .claude/state.

bypassKeyword.description: Single-use keyword in a prompt that arms a plan-first bypass for the next edit. Default #no-plan.

secretPatterns.description: Secret-file detection tuning for the read guard.

extra.description: Extra regexes matched against a path to treat it as a secret file.

tokenVars.description: Identifier names that must never be logged (console.log/print of these is blocked).

customRules.description: Opt-in per-path banned patterns. Each rule blocks bannedPattern when the edited path starts with pathPrefix.

pathPrefix.description: Path prefix (project-dir-relative) the rule applies under.

bannedPattern.description: Regex that, if present in the new content, blocks the edit.

message.description: Explanation shown when the rule fires.

enabled.description: Enable the git-status diff after Bash. Default true.

sourceGlobs.description: Globs that count as source (warn candidates).

testGlobs.description: Globs that count as tests (touching one silences the nudge).

throttleMinutes.description: Per-session minimum gap between warnings. Default 10.

inProgressPolicy.description: Interplay with in_progress audit tasks. 'skip-gate-only' (default) or 'skip-all'.

usage.description: Token metering (meter-usage.py, /audit:usage). The ledger records counts, model ids, timestamps, branch and author - never prompt content.

ledgerDir.description: Repo-relative directory holding the monthly NDJSON ledger and its scan cursors. Default '.claude/usage'. Deliberately outside stateDir, which is GC'd after 7 days.

authorMode.description: How the spender is recorded: git user.email (default), git user.name, a short salt-free sha256 ('hash', pseudonymous but still groupable), or no author at all.

showCost.description: Show equivalent API cost alongside tokens. Default true. Labelled 'equiv' because subscription plans carry no per-token bill.

backfillOnFirstRun.description: On first sight of a transcript, scan it from the start (bounded by maxScanBytes) instead of metering only from now on. Default true.

maxScanBytes.description: First-sight backfill ceiling in bytes; above it the scan seeks to EOF so the 10s hook timeout stays safe. Default 33554432 (32 MiB). '/audit:usage --backfill' has no ceiling.

currency.description: Currency label for the pricing table. Default 'USD'.

pricingAsOf.description: Date the shipped pricing table was accurate, surfaced in the report so a stale rate is visible.

pricing.description: Model id -> rate row. Lookup is exact match, then longest matching prefix (so a dated id resolves to its family), then the '_default' row.

additionalProperties.description: USD per MILLION tokens for one model. Cache rates follow the published multipliers off base input: write 1.25x at the 5-minute TTL, 2x at the 1-hour TTL, read 0.1x.
